experiments.question: Do predictions improve if part of each past game's shot-making luck (FG points above what a league-average shooter scores on the same shots) is removed from its margin before fitting?
experiments.method: Walk-forward backtest, same settings as the live model; luck_weight 0 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75. Decision made on the tuning season only.
experiments.decision: Rejected. On the tuning season 0 was best (log loss 0.5976 vs 0.5979 at 0.25, worse beyond). Shot data is kept as information for the analyst, not in the model.
experiments.note: Shot luck here includes real shooting skill as well as streaks, which is a likely reason removing it doesn't help. A version that separates the two (player's own long-run shooting vs this game) is a candidate for a later test.

experiments.question: Teleios's player projections sat right on the betting lines for rebounds, assists and threes on Nov 23, yet it called the under 55-60% of the time and lost to the bettors on 575 lines. Does a learned correction of its over/under chances fix that?
experiments.method: Daily, automatic (teleios/calibrate.py): logistic recalibration of Teleios's raw chance of OVER, fit on older nights, tested on the newest nights it never saw. Adopted only if the held-out Brier score improves by at least 0.002; dropped again if it stops earning its place.

results.note: Waiting for 3 graded nights and 1,200 lines. Dry run on Nov 23 split into pretend nights: held-out Brier 0.2525 -> 0.2356 (machinery check only).

experiments.decision: Pending: decided automatically once enough nights are graded.

experiments.question: Prop Edge blends about 20% of the betting line into its player projections and was more accurate than Teleios on Nov 23 (points 4.55 vs 4.77, PRA 5.52 vs 5.95). Does blending part of the market's center into Teleios's projections help?
experiments.method: Daily, automatic (teleios/lineblend.py): one blend weight per stat (0-80%), chosen on older nights, tested on the newest nights it never saw. Adopted only if the average miss improves by at least 0.5% with no stat more than 1% worse.

results.note: Waiting for 3 graded nights and 1,200 lines. Dry run on Nov 23 split into pretend nights: chose 60-80% blends; held-out average miss 3.4% lower (machinery check only).

experiments.decision: Pending: decided automatically once enough nights are graded.
